caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular architectural relief featuring two horse heads emerging from the central portion. The horses, rendered in shades of brown and gray, face forward with their muzzles slightly turned toward each other. Both horses wear harnesses outlined in a yellowish-gold color. The relief is bordered on the top and bottom by a brown horizontal frame. Ornamental elements include symmetrical arrangements of bronze-gold acanthus leaves and berries at the lower left and right, extending outward from the horse heads. Behind each horse, a thin rod or staff runs horizontally, continuing behind the foliage on both sides. The background is a plain off-white, and the drawing is illuminated in a way that emphasizes the three-dimensional quality of the sculptural forms and decorative details.
title: Barn Decoration
